column3: (Content Security Policy - API doesn't serve HTML)

(Storable and Cacheable Content - the scan is anonymous and the public GETs it reaches are meant to be cacheable; the reads handing out the caller's own account state - session list, security journal, username change - declare no-store, and ResponseCachePolicyShould fails when one of them stops)
(Timestamp Disclosure - matches numeric ids and counters that merely look like Unix epochs; no timestamp here is secret)
(Modern Web Application - informational, reports that the target behaves like an SPA; not a defect)
(Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy - require-corp would block images served from MinIO/imgproxy on another origin; deliberately unset)

(CSP wildcard - img-src keeps the https: scheme source because [img] renders user-supplied external URLs verbatim; narrowing it requires proxying every external image first. NOTE: this rule id also covers "directive with no fallback", which is why form-action/base-uri/object-src/frame-src are now set explicitly in SecurityHeadersMiddleware rather than relied upon here)
